**Whitespace on the country card.** In 0.6.0 the official-language block entered
the card's three-column grid as a fourth item; the grid opened a second row, and
a section holding a single badge took up a whole column. The official language is
part of the country's identity anyway, so it has moved into the main column
alongside the family and writing-system lines, separated by a thin rule. The card
is back to three columns.

Fixing that closed **a gap older than 0.6.0** as well: the action links ("Split
Türkiye into regions", "Show the countries where … is spoken") were pinned to the
grid's first column and therefore waited for the tallest column to end — on the
Türkiye card that left 205 pixels of nothing in between. They now sit side by side
on the final row, spanning every column. The Türkiye card went from 840 pixels
tall to 467.

One redundant box is gone too: countries whose official language is declared in
law and matches the home language no longer draw an empty badge row.

The map itself is unchanged — still pixel for pixel identical to 0.5.3 in the
home layer.
